golf_r: Gruff loaded midrange, clearer intake, short irregular overrun cluster and bounded DSG cut.
mini_jcw: Loaded intake/exhaust split, gruff low-mid growl and the strongest short overrun burble cluster.
gr_yaris: Three-cylinder pressure beat and rougher loaded flow, restrained burble and short turbo release.
gla45: Sharper M139 four-cylinder snarl, low-mid load growth and short overrun burble; audible matched blip.
corolla: Quieter commuter NA-four buzz, restrained intake and no sport exhaust effects.
octavia_rs: Rounded EA888-style gruff midrange, moderate induction and restrained overrun.

carrera_gts: Less muffled flat-six rasp/howl, stronger induction, controlled short overrun and long phase-coherent recording beds.
aventador_svj: V12 intake/exhaust separation and longer phase-coherent beds; corrected limiter bounce. Exhaust pops remain OFF.
